title: [bug] select_channel GNSS path returns out-of-bounds channel when n_channels<=1
description: The n_channels<=1 guard added at commit 7e54571 only protects Priority 3 (hash-based), not Priority 2 (GNSS-synced). When GNSS is enabled with n_channels=1, select_channel returns 1 but only channel 0 is valid. synchronized_hop_channel(sfn, seed, n_channels=1) always returns 1 via 1+(hash%1), violating the [0,n_channels-1] contract. Test: select_channel(peer_known=False, n_channels=1, time_provider=valid_gnss, gnss_config=enabled) returns 1 instead of 0.
